intro.text: Aura Systems, Inc. (“Aura”), is a Delaware corporation founded in 1987. The Company innovated and commercialized the technology for Axial Flux Induction electric motors and generators. “Axial flux motors represent a leap forward in motor technology, offering high efficiency, compact design, and lightweight construction. As industries continue to push for more efficient technologies, the axial flux motor design is a promising solution that combines power, scalability, and superior performance. Its ability to deliver energy savings while minimizing space and weight is likely to propel this motor design into wide use across many sectors, shaping the future of motor-driven systems .” 1
